question: package joules per first view of recorded public pages, served by a local replay of the recorded responses, with the same pages served again with their embeds as facades where an iframe changes

method.idle windows: one before the first window and one after every 6 windows
method.arm order: pages rotated per round; the facade arm runs only on a page whose iframes the rewrite changes, and its order rotates too
method.replay: Chromium through host-resolver-rules to a local HTTPS server that sends each recorded response with its recorded content-encoding; a new cold context per navigation; no service worker, no cache; requests to hosts the page never used are counted apart as outside
method.origin CPU: the replay server runs on this host, so its CPU is inside the package counter; each row carries its CPU as originCpuMs and it is not subtracted
method.rounds run: 3 were configured; the run was stopped after round 1 completed and the 18 rows of round 2 already written were dropped before publishing, so every page has exactly 2 rounds
method.certificate: Chromium with --ignore-certificate-errors against a self-signed replay certificate; each navigation is a new cold context with no service worker and no HTTP cache
method.corpus recorded with: Accept-Encoding sent and a 256 KiB response-header limit, so recorded bodies keep their content-encoding and YouTube embed responses are present; rice.edu-2 and swarthmore.edu-3 are YouTube pages with no embed recorded
method.status: first-view cost of a replayed public page on a desktop; it does not include the service worker install or provisioning cost of spool
